titulo: Elon Musk’s attempt at an AI Wikipedia hasn’t been updated in months
cuerpo: xAI's Grokipedia, an online encyclopedia with AI-generated articles that Elon Musk once promised would be a "massive improvement" over Wikipedia, apparently hasn't been updated since April 24th, according to a report from Lawfare.
